text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the small student garden plot at Tracen 
Academy, Mejiro Palmer was busy digging up 
the soil—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah! Soil! Inversion! Flip~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
!! Not bad, Palmer! Just like I taught ya, 
the fresh dirt's comin' right up to the 
top!
choice_data_list:
Huh, I didn't know there was a technique 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san. Pretty cool, right? My 
hole-digging technique!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I once leveled the yard back home to make 
a putting green, so this much is a total 
breeze♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oho, pretty confident, aren't ya? In that 
case, let's have a race!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can till their way to the 
end of the patch faster and cleaner!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so in♪ Time to stylishly beat my 
master!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOHHHH~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: P-Ptui!? I got a whole mouthful of dirt~~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That's just part of workin' the 
fields!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, I won't lose! Take thiiiis~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*cough* *spit*!? Hey, throwin' it on 
purpose is a foul~!
choice_data_list: Haha, take it easy, you two.
Haha, don't overdo it, you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Trainer-san, keep your guard up 
too—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Time to dig like crazy all the 
way to the end—!!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Ace
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah~~~!! Doryaaaah~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dirt flies through the air, forming an arc 
like a rainbow. In no time, both of them 
reach the edge of the patch—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pfft*, fufu... Ahahaha! Ace-san, you're 
totally covered in mud!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Look who's talkin', you're just 
as bad!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Man, workin' the fields really is the 
best. You can't get a feelin' like this in 
regular classes, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I totally get that! It really makes 
you feel alive~!
choice_data_list:
You two looked like you were having a 
blast.

Both of you seemed to be having so much 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Halfway through, I was even 
thinking, 'Aww, I don't want this to 
end~.'

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's keep farmin' together from now 
on. I'll invite you again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yay! You promise, okay?! And of course, we 
gotta race next time too♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, next time, as a farmer's daughter, 
I'm gonna leave you in the dust for real!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oho, guess I'd better start taking my 
training seriously too♪
choice_data_list: I have a feeling stamina's gonna be key!
Looks like guts will decide the match.
Looks like guts will decide the match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oho, guess I'd better start taking my 
training seriously too♪
choice_data_list: I have a feeling stamina's gonna be key!
Looks like guts will decide the match.
Looks like guts will decide the match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Guess I'll start with some steady 
distance running!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, what you eat matters too! 
Especially green onions and garlic— 
they're essential for buildin' stamina!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh... Eat veggies to build 
stamina, have fun tilling the field and 
harvesting—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that an endless loop?! Getting 
stronger while eating delicious food is 
way too awesome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, mental training, huh... I wonder if I 
can push myself hard enough~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Then tendin' to the field is perfect for 
that. If you don't put your back into it, 
the veggies will wither right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's just the right amount of 
pressure! It actually makes it more 
exciting♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'll grow some super tasty veggies and 
blow Ace-san away!
